basic_details.job_title: SRFTI Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute Kolkata (SRFTI) has announced 1 vacancy for the Accounts Officer post under advertisement number SRFTI/RECTT/2026-27/006. Candidates applying for the post require a Degree in Commerce from a recognized University or equivalent, passed ICWA/CA – intermediate, at least eight years professional experience in computerized accounts, and knowledge of Government Rules and Regulations, with the pay specified at Level-7 (44900-142400). Eligible applicants must apply through the online application form, deposit an application fee of Rs. 1,200 through SBI Collect,

how_to_apply: Visit the online application portal at career.srfti.ac.in and submit the online application form.

Pay the application fee of Rs. 1,200 through SBI Collect by selecting category as Educational Institutions, searching for Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute, and choosing the payment category "Application Fees (Recruitment)".
Upload the payment confirmation receipt during the online application submission and store the receipt for future reference.
Submit the online application form on or before 09.11.2026.

Forward the printout of the filled application along with a copy of all requisite documents to “The Registrar, Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute, E. M. Bypass Road, P.O. Panchasayar, Kolkata – 700 094” within 16.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 unreserved (UR) vacancy for the post of Accounts Officer under direct recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational and professional requirements prescribed for the SRFTI Accounts Officer post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.essential_qualification: Degree in Commerce from a recognized University or equivalent. Passed ICWA/CA – intermediate. At least Eight years Pro-fessional experience in the field of computerized accounts. Knowledge of Government Rules and Regulations.
rows.desirable_qualification: Passed ICWA/CA. Diploma in Financial Management. Candidates are required to produce evidence of work done.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post of Accounts Officer carries the pay scale of Level-7 (44900-142400) as per the 7th CPC. The appointment is made on a direct recruitment basis in Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute, Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SRFTI Accounts Officer
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal at career.srfti.ac.in and submit the online application form. Pay the application fee of Rs. 1,200 through SBI Collect by selecting category as Educational Institutions, searching for Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute, and choosing the payment category "Application Fees (Recruitment)". Upload the payment confirmation receipt during the online application submission and store the receipt for future reference. Submit the online application form on or before 09.11.2026. Forward the printout of the filled application along with a copy of all requisite documents to “The Registrar, Satyajit Ray Film & Television Institute, E. M. Bypass Road, P.O. Panchasayar, Kolkata – 700 094” within 16.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Depending on the number of applications, eligible short-listed candidates will be called for a trade test, written test, and/or interview. Since it is not possible to call all eligible candidates, applicants are short-listed based on criteria fixed by the Institute at the time of scrutiny.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for SRFTI Accounts Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form is 09.11.2026, and the hard copy of the application must reach the Institute by 16.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PWD, and female applicants are exempted from payment of application fees.

faq.question: Q3. What age relaxations are applicable for the SRFTI Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: Age is relaxable for Government servants (other than SRFTI) as per Govt. of India's extant orders, and the same relaxation is admissible to employees of Central/State Autonomous Bodies and Public Sector Enterprises. For contractual employees of SRFTI only, the upper age limit is relaxable by the number of years of service rendered in SRFTI, while upper age limit is not applicable to regular employees of SRFTI.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Applicants are short-listed on the basis of criteria fixed by the Institute at the time of scrutiny, depending on the number of applications received, to be called for a trade test, written test, and/or interview.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be enclosed with the printed application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of certificate as proof of age, certificates of qualifications, certificate of caste, certificates of experience, two copies of recent passport size photographs, and the payment receipt of Rs. 1,200.
